How much does it cost to work with Start Apps Studio?

The public path has four routes: a $2,600 Launch Site for a credible story before the full product, a $6,000 Prototype to make the idea tangible for validation or fundraising, an MVP from $15,000 to $30,000 to put a real product in users' hands, and Custom from $25,000 or monthly retainer for a bespoke system. We agree on scope and price before work starts, so you know the investment behind the next milestone.
How long does it take to ship an MVP?

The MVP route typically ships in 3 to 8 weeks from kickoff, depending on scope. Launch Sites are typically delivered in 3 to 5 business days and Prototypes in 5 to 10 days. We work in tight weekly cycles with shared previews, so you can make the next decision from what you see rather than waiting until the end.
What is included in an MVP build?

An MVP gives you the core product to learn from with real users: product design, a working iOS, Android, or web app, authentication, a database, payments where relevant, deployment to your accounts, and a basic landing page. You get the source code, a written handoff doc, and a walkthrough so a future team can pick up the next stage.
Who owns the code, designs, and accounts?

You do. All source code, design files, and third-party accounts (App Store, Google Play, hosting, database, payments) are created in your name and transferred to you. There is no lock-in to Start Apps Studio. You can keep building with us, take it to another team, or hire in-house.
What stack do you build on?

We default to React and React Native (via Expo) on the front end, with Node and Postgres on the back end, deployed to Replit, Vercel, or your preferred host. We pick the stack to match the founder, not the other way around. If you have an existing codebase or a strong preference, we work in it.
What happens after launch? Do you offer ongoing support?

Every build includes a 2-week post-launch window where we fix anything broken on us, free of charge. After that, you can run with the codebase, bring in an in-house engineer, or keep us accountable for the next stage through a monthly retainer. For larger or more complex products, Custom engagements can be structured around the 1–6 month build you need.
Can you help if I already run a business?

Yes. We work with new ventures, family businesses, and established teams. We can refresh an outdated website, shape a stronger brand presence, or turn an existing operation into a useful digital product. You stay close to the decisions while one accountable partner owns the build.
Can you help me build something to show investors?

Yes. If people need to experience the idea before you build the full product, the $6,000 Prototype gives investors, partners, or customers something interactive to react to. It typically takes 5 to 10 days for a Figma-led clickable prototype; if you need real users to use the product, an MVP is the better route and typically takes 3 to 8 weeks.
Can I get just a landing page without a full app build?

Yes. If your next milestone is a credible launch or marketing presence, our $2,600 Launch Site gives you a polished, responsive website without committing to the full product build. We shape the message around your audience, build it in your Lovable or Replit account, then deploy and hand over an editable site in 3 to 5 business days.
Can you take over an existing project or vibe-coded prototype?

Yes. We frequently take over half-built apps from Lovable, Bolt, v0, Cursor, or freelance teams. We start with a short paid audit, give you an honest read on what is salvageable, and either rebuild the weak parts or finish the MVP. Either way, you walk away with a clean, shippable codebase you actually own.
